title: selaginella articulata
intro: Selaginella articulata, commonly known as Articulated Spikemoss, is a type of non-vascular, perennial plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella articulata, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions make it a potential candidate for the development of novel drugs and natural remedies.
